product_facts: Brand Concierge is Adobe's platform for conversational experiences on your website, mobile apps and other digital properties. Every conversation is grounded in your own content and guardrails.
Brand Concierge answers visitors' questions from the content you approve.

Brand Concierge answers only from the knowledge sources you configure (website pages, PDFs and product spreadsheets), not from general world knowledge. Website sources refresh on a schedule you set, so answers keep up with the pages you publish.

When a question falls outside those sources, the concierge is designed to say it does not have the information rather than generate an unsupported answer, and guardrails can exclude topics such as legal or compliance matters.

Brand Concierge is focused on anonymous visitors: it answers from the conversation and your knowledge sources, not from an individual customer's records. Questions about a customer's own account would go to your secure channels.

Before launch, it is tested against a golden set of real customer questions paired with ideal answers, including questions it should not answer; after launch, conversation transcripts are reviewed on a recurring basis.

services.template_assumptions:
The Client has licensed Sites Optimizer for AEM Sites (Edge Delivery, Cloud Service or Managed Services) and the site is a public production site. Hours scale with the number of sites.

How a fix is deployed depends on its opportunity. With the Ultimate package, approved content fixes go into authoring (on document-authored Edge Delivery sites, into the source documents) for people to review and publish, and Core Web Vitals fixes are prepared as code patches for a named developer who reviews, tests, merges and releases them. Deploying to authoring and preparing code patches each need the user's permission for that action and a fully configured site (Adobe's example is a connected code repository).

Code patches reach the developer as a pull request in the connected repository or as a downloaded patch. On AEM as a Cloud Service sites, broken-backlink redirects are deployed through Dispatcher.

With Prime, which identifies and suggests fixes, the first agreed content and configuration fixes are applied by hand and code fixes go to the named developer.

Core Web Vitals come from real-user data (Operational Telemetry, connected during setup if it isn't yet), and Adobe analyzes them only on pages with at least 1,000 page views.

Brand Visibility connects its own Search Console link; one access request to the Client covers both. Access for Adobe's scanner is confirmed here and its IP addresses are allowed in the CDN, firewall or Cloud Manager traffic filters.
services.template_exclusions: The Sites Optimizer license, fixes outside the agreed opportunity types, and changes to systems outside AEM.
services.template_basis: One site: Sites Optimizer connected, roles set, and the first SEO opportunities reviewed with the team.

product_facts: Journey Optimizer is Adobe's application for creating and delivering connected, personalized customer experiences across your channels. It is built on Adobe Experience Platform and its real-time customer profile, and runs both real-time journeys and scheduled campaigns.
Journey Optimizer orchestrates the journeys and campaigns and delivers the messages across channels.

We would set Journey Optimizer up in the order Adobe documents: the environment first, with a development sandbox for building and testing and a production sandbox for sending, each with its own channel configurations. Journeys are tested with test profiles before activation.

A journey automates a real-time, multi-step sequence of interactions; a campaign sends a scheduled or API-triggered message to an audience. Messages are delivered through channels like email, mobile messages, push notifications and direct mail.
Journey Optimizer tracks customer engagement and campaign performance with reports, and its reporting is integrated with Customer Journey Analytics for a clearer view of performance metrics.

When messages are sent from journeys or campaigns, your customers must always be able to unsubscribe; once they do, their profiles are automatically removed from the audience of future marketing messages.
